journey.name: Log an anchor
journey.description: A user logs their wake time from Today, undoes it, logs it again, and sees it counted on Today.

actions.action: Verify the Today screen is shown with the headline "Ready when you are"
Verify a message saying Wake was logged is shown with an "Undo" button
Verify the text "1 of 6 logged today." is shown
Verify the headline "Ready when you are" is shown again
Verify the Rhythm screen is shown
Verify the text "1 of 6 logged today." is shown
